title: Schönhauser Allee Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **The stretch:** about **1.9 km** from **U Senefelderplatz** to **S+U Schönhauser Allee**, about **25 minutes** on foot without stops.
**The viaduct:** the **U2** comes out of the ground about **500 m** north of Senefelderplatz and runs on a steel viaduct of **1913**, nicknamed the **Magistratsschirm**.
**Stops:** the **Jewish Cemetery** of 1827, the **Kulturbrauerei**, **Konnopke's Imbiss** under the tracks, **Eberswalder Straße** and the **Ringbahn** crossing.
**Christmas:** the **Lucia market** in the Kulturbrauerei runs **23 November to 22 December 2026**, free entry.
**Best day:** **Tuesday to Friday**, when the cemetery, Konnopke's and the market are all open.
**Right now:** trains towards Pankow were not stopping at **Senefelderplatz** on 26 November, and the north entrance of **U Schönhauser Allee** is closed for bridge works.
**My move:** start at the cemetery, wait for one train to climb the ramp, then walk north under the tracks.
